title: Windows Server 2025 Security
contentHtml:
In this episode Michael and Sarah talk with guest Orin Thomas ( ) about the latest security improvements in Windows Server 2025. We realize this is not pure Azure, but Windows is a common VM type used in the cloud.
We also discuss Azure Security news about CosmosDB, Post Quantum Crypto (of course!), ASP.NET and TLS 1.3 hybrid post quantum support and more.
